expectations.text: Presentation state carries a Ui marker (AddItemUiState), no bare collision with domain AddItemState
expectations.evidence: Declares `class AddItemUiState`; domain AddItemState only imported.

expectations.text: UiState render data built from read-model projection (WardrobeViewState), not the Decider write-model
expectations.evidence: `final WardrobeViewState? wardrobe;` populated only via WardrobeService.wardrobe().

expectations.text: Uses a Cubit (not event-driven Bloc) for the 1:1 command screen
expectations.evidence: AddItemCubit extends Cubit<AddItemUiState>; no UiEvent hierarchy.

expectations.text: UiState models initial/loading/success/failure and uses value equality
expectations.evidence: enum AddItemStatus; extends Equatable with props.

expectations.text: Application service injected via constructor, not constructed inside the Cubit
expectations.evidence: AddItemCubit(this._service); WardrobeService built at composition root.

expectations.text: DomainError mapped to a failure UI state, not propagated to the widget
expectations.evidence: `on DomainError catch (e)` -> emit failure status (3 occurrences).
